chunks: When they board a ship they call on God, placing their faith wholly in Him. But when He brings them safely back to shore, they begin to associate others with Him,

key_terms.الدِّينَ: religion/devotion (in the sense of sincere submission)

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about human behavior during hardship versus ease?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse illustrates the human tendency toward 'forgetfulness' (ghaflah) during ease, contrasting the sincere supplication of the distressed with the ingratitude of the safe. It serves as a critique of conditional faith, emphasizing that true devotion requires consistency beyond mere crisis management. The imagery of the ship underscores the transient nature of worldly safety compared to the permanence of divine reliance.
